title: REPLACEMENT
text: REPLACEMENT. The first one I received was broken. I like that it was replaced without a problem. I love the way it looks. My desert rose looks beautiful sitting on this stand. It is sturdy as long as you don't move it around with items on top of it. They do not make things like they used to but this stand serves its purpose well.
